messages.subject: Debugging with logs
parts:
Greetings.

I am able to RHadoop jobs with thousands of mappers. There is an occasional problem occurring in the system that the values between the different keys are mixed up and written in the mappers. When I try to debug with mappers logs and reducers logs, it became cumbersome since it has thousands of files spread across multiple nodes in the cluster. Is there any mechanism n RHadoop to do a central logging of the logs (i.e.) using a scribe server.

(E.g.) http://blog.cloudera.com/blog/2008/11/configuring-and-using-scribe-for-hadoop-log-collection/

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#394] Debugging with logs

No there isn't such a thing. It sounds inherently non scalable, by the way.
